audit.whatIsWrong: The content-layer whys[] narrate Aatrox owning levels 3 through first item, which contradicts both the full-layer phases (Garen 4/7) and the 52.6% Garen win rate over 5048 games.
audit.why: Two layers of the same page disagreed on who wins each stage. The full layer and win[] tokens already favour Garen; only the whys[] prose said otherwise.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[0..6] so the stage narrative matches win[]: Garen wins the level-2 and level-3 windows on Decisive Strike's silence and W's shield/tenacity, 4-5 flattens on Deathbringer healing, level 6 hinges on World Ender's 120s cooldown, and two items plus Grievous Wounds hand Garen the stat-check.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text claims World Ender grants 'a revive on takedown'. It does not — a takedown extends the duration only.
audit.why: Riot's own description in the kit file says World Ender gives fear on minions, bonus attack damage, increased healing and Move Speed, and that a takedown extends the effect. No revive. The revive was removed from the ability years ago.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now states the real spike: a 120/100/80-second commit granting AD, range and increased healing, extended (not restarted as a revive) by a takedown, and the two-minute punish window that follows it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive kit interaction was never stated: Decisive Strike (Q) silences, and The Darkin Blade is a three-swing chain — silencing Aatrox mid-chain denies the remaining swings. Also unstated: Deathbringer Stance (P) is an auto-attack reset, so the auto wind-up, not an ability cast, is the tell.
audit.why: Garen's Q flag is 'silence: denies ability casts'; Aatrox's Q text is explicitly 'He can swing three times'. Silence landing between swings is the single largest damage denial in the lane and it appeared nowhere on the page. The missing-interactions feed also flagged the Deathbringer auto-reset tell.
audit.corrected: mid now says to cast Decisive Strike as his Q chain starts so the remaining swings never come out, and names the Deathbringer Stance auto-reset wind-up as the cue to step back. spikes[0] adds W's shield-plus-tenacity as the answer to Q3, with The Darkin Blade at 12s cooldown at rank 2.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Extend into his R healing' but its body text is boilerplate about your own committal tool.
audit.why: Title and body described different things, so the concrete cooldown number never reached the reader.
audit.corrected: Body replaced with the real number: World Ender is 120s at rank 1, so break off and take the fight in the window it is down.

audit.why: Mortal Reminder / Bramble is already called out against Deathbringer Stance and World Ender's increased healing, which is the right anti-heal timing.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — both champs lack the tools to force a meaningful trade.
edits.after: Level 1 is even, but Q chip plus Perseverance regen refills what he trades.

edits.before: Level 2 stays a skill check; neither has enough for a committed all-in.
edits.after: Level 2 favours you: W's shield and tenacity blunt his Q3 knockup.

edits.before: Aatrox leads at 3 once his second Q sweet-spot out-trades your spin.
edits.after: At 3 your Q silence cuts his Q chain dead, then E spins two ticks free.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his Q combo and passive healing out-damage your Judgment.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his Deathbringer heal off you swings it back to a coinflip.

edits.before: At 6 his World Ender stat-boost, range and revive beat you when your ult is down.
edits.after: At 6 World Ender's 120s cooldown decides it — commit only while it is down.

edits.before: First item, his Eclipse/Goredrinker sustain wins the long trade.
edits.after: First item, Stridebreaker makes your Q run-down inescapable for him.

edits.before: With two items and Grievous Wounds it flattens back to an even skill check.
edits.after: With two items and Grievous Wounds his sustain dies and you stat-check him.

edits.before: Aatrox spikes once he has two points in Q — the second and third sweet-spots out-trade your Decisive Strike since your Judgment E gets clipped by his knock-up and healed off by his passive.
edits.after: Aatrox spikes on two points in Q — the later swings hit harder and The Darkin Blade is down to 12s. Pop W before his third swing lands: the shield and its tenacity blunt the knockup and you win the re-trade.

edits.before: World Ender gives him a stat boost, extended range and a revive on takedown; if he all-ins while your R is down he wins the extended fight even through your Perseverance regen.
edits.after: World Ender is a 120-second commit at rank 1: bonus AD, range and increased healing, and a takedown only extends it — there is no revive. Ride it out with W up, then punish the next two minutes.

edits.before: His Q sweet-spots plus Eclipse/Goredrinker healing let him win the second-wind portion of any extended trade you both commit to.
edits.after: His Q edges plus Eclipse healing win the second half of any long trade — so buy Mortal Reminder and keep every trade under three seconds.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are even skill-checks — neither of you has the kit to commit, so last-hit safely and stay out of his Q range for free poke.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours on attrition: chip him on his last-hits, break contact, and let Perseverance refill you for free while he stays down.

edits.before: From level 3 to 6 Aatrox owns the lane: his Q sweet-spots out-range and out-damage your spin, his passive heals the chunk off your Judgment, and his knock-up interrupts your channel. Only trade when his Q is down.
edits.after: From 3 to 6 your Q silence is the lane: cast it as his Q chain starts and the remaining swings never come out. Take two E ticks, leave, regen. His Deathbringer Stance auto reset is the wind-up tell to step back.

edits.before: Hit his R window while your R is down for the revive threat
edits.after: Hit his R window while your R is down and drag it long

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: World Ender is 120s at rank 1 — break off, wait it out, and take the fight in the two minutes it is not up.

notes: The packet levelChart (Aatrox 4/7, Garen 0) contradicts both the 52.6% win rate and the full-layer phases, which already give Garen 4 stages. I left the phase/win tokens alone because full and content already agree with each other and with the win rate; the packet chart is the stale one and should be regenerated from the full layer rather than the reverse. Removed a factual error that appeared twice: World Ender has no revive — a takedown extends the duration only.
